title: TV panel timing controller: frame scan-out from memory over AXI4 to a V-by-One HS style 8-lane link
features: Lane training (D10.2) until vbo_lockn_n is low; idle K28.5; K28.2 before line 0 and K28.0 before every other line.
4-byte mode: pixel p of a line goes to lane p % LANES, byte j in symbol j; a new symbol every SYM_DIV clocks (0 counts as 1), vbo_sym on its first clock.
CMD.start scans out V_ACTIVE lines of H_ACTIVE pixels from FB_ADDR + k * STRIDE, HBLANK idle symbols between lines.
STATUS.underrun: the line FIFO ran empty inside a line (zeros sent); lock loss during a frame ends it (LOCK interrupt).

fields.desc: scan out one frame; ignored while busy
lock was lost during the frame
lines sent by the current / last frame

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a job ended that saw an AXI error response

sequence: Write FB_ADDR, GEOM, TIMING and IRQ_ENABLE.
Write CMD.start = 1 once per frame (on DONE).
notes: m_* is the AXI4 manager port (32-bit address and data, 4-bit ID, no user / QoS); it passes through unchanged. Bursts are INCR, AxSIZE = 2 (4 bytes), 1 to 16 beats, WSTRB = 4'hF, never across a 4 KB boundary; one read and one write burst are outstanding at a time.
vbo_lane_d / vbo_lane_k / vbo_sym (out) and vbo_htpdn_n / vbo_lockn_n (in) are the link pins; serialisation and 8b/10b coding are in the PHY.
The core testbench prints one `LAT <master> dram R|W <cycles>` line per AXI burst (tb/tv_lat_mon.svh), the regression suite's latency format.
